0022600226.text: The Thunder, 8-2 and on a four-game winning streak, visit the 6-3 Trail Blazers, who have lost their last two, as Oklahoma City seeks its 12th game of the season with a 5-0 home record and a 3-2 road mark so far. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 124-95 win in Oklahoma City on December 31. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber, and Portland is missing Ja Morant, Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci.
